summary: Fits splines to polygon or hull input and outputs polygonal approximations with several resampling and endpoint controls.

key_params.name: first
key_params.note: First CV count for open curve endpoints

key_params.name: last
key_params.note: Last CV count for open curve endpoints

common_gotchas: Even-length mode is invalid when both output divisions and segment length are zero.
The output is still polygonal, so it is an approximation of the fitted spline.
Basis choice and closure mode can materially change endpoint and hull behavior.
key_concepts: Polyspline SOP fits spline curves to polygon or hull inputs, then outputs polygonal approximations.
It can preserve original point divisions or create equal-length, axis, or edge-based divisions.
First and last CV counts affect open-curve endpoint behavior.
Viewport point display is useful for inspecting the generated divisions and endpoint handling.
